content: <thought>The mass spectrum shows a base peak at m/z 183.045, which in positive‑mode ESI corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The prominent M+2 peak at +2 Da with ~33 % intensity is characteristic of a single chlorine atom (⁴⁰Cl/³⁷Cl isotopic pattern). Accounting for one ³⁵Cl (34.968852 Da) leaves 147.069 Da to be composed of C, H, and O. The combination C₆H₁₁O₄ matches this residual mass within ~0.003 Da, and the DBE calculation (C – (H+Cl)/2 + 1 = 1) is chemically reasonable. Therefore the molecular formula that fits the exact mass and isotopic pattern is C₆H₁₁O₄Cl.
